title: Tahini Sauce
summary: This tahini sauce is smooth, pourable, and packed with flavor. It’s an easy homemade version that takes just minutes to make and works as a dip, dressing, or drizzle for all your favorite meals.
ingredients: 1 garlic grated or pressed (can add more to taste)
steps: In a medium bowl or jar, add all the ingredients.

Whisk everything together until the sauce becomes smooth and creamy. If it looks too thick at first, keep whisking – it will come together. If needed, add a bit more water, 1 tablespoon at a time, until you reach your desired consistency.
Taste and adjust. Taste and adjust seasoning if needed – add more lemon juice for tang, salt for flavor, or a touch more water to thin it out.
